author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The MagicX One35 is another sub-$100 handheld that provides and excellent mix of performance, screen, controls, and price.  Let's test it out and demonstrate why it's one of the better retro handhelds you can buy right now.

Buy one here: https://tinyurl.com/MagicX-One35
MagicX GitHub: https://github.com/Magicx-Breeze/One35

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
